name: Polly
author: Charles Vestal
tagline: A pocket arranger for the FM-1
description: Polly is a pocket arranger for the M-VAVE FM-1, inspired by the Yamaha QY70. A style plays a band of eight instruments, and the chords you play steer it. Songs are made of sections, each playing a chord progression, with two melodies running along them. The sounds come from the General MIDI set of Sonivox EAS, and MIDI in plays them too, so Polly also works as a General MIDI sound module.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments). GM sounds: Sonivox EAS (Apache-2.0). Drums: the Groove MIDI Dataset (CC BY 4.0).
